title: vakint
description: A library for computing single-scale vacuum integrals in high-energy physics through topology matching, tensor reduction, analytical methods, and numerical sector decomposition.
notes: Vakint-authored source is available under the MIT License. Because vakint uses Symbolica for some computations, library consumers must configure their own Symbolica license; GammaLoop's OEM license does not transfer to standalone vakint use.
